_comment: cart board (variants A and B share it). Frame: origin west-south corner, +x toward the cartridge cap end, +y = north edge (USB-C wall). Same chip set as electronics/v010/cup (HJ-840, STM32C011, TPL5010, TPS2553, TPS61023, 2 x DRV8838, MCP73832, USB-C, RGB LED, sounder, side button, TMAG5273 strip); no dock hall on the board (adapter-lock DRV5032 on a 3-wire pigtail). Interlock unchanged (INTERLOCK.md).

usb_c.part: TYPE-C-31-M-14 mid-mount (C223907), as the cup board
usb_c.note: receptacle mouth flush with the housing wall inner face, which is board_wall_clr beyond the north edge (cup notch geometry kept relative to the mouth)

button_sw1.part: SKSCLAE010 side switch (cup BOM) on the BOTTOM face

antenna_zone.rule: HJ-840 antenna end at the EAST end, no copper on any layer, no parts (VERIFY against the HJ-840 footprint)

wire_pads_west_end.note: motor 4 + cell 2 + TMAG strip + lock-hall pigtail soldered at the west end (spec 1a exception, as the cup pod)

A.under_board: cell (front); motor / TMAG strip are beside the board (wired)
